refs: Psa 19:1 , The creatures shew God's glory

3.heading: There:
refs: Or, "They have no speech, nor words, nor is their voice heard

yet into all the earth hath gone out their sound, and to the extremity of the world their words." The Hebrew, kav, rendered, line, like the Greek φθογγος, by which the LXX - who are followed by St. Paul render it, no doubt signifies the sound as well as the cord which emits it. The Vulgate, Jerome, and Symmachus, render it to the same purpose. Deut 4:19
or, without these their voice is heard, Heb. without their voice heard
